_doc: Data dictionary for the open-data downloads (PLAN F4). Column definitions follow pipeline/src/hhdebt/transform.py (METHODOLOGY) and supabase/migrations/20261027000000_init.sql. `licence` is one of the keys in `licences`; `redistribute: false` tables are listed with a link to the original source instead of a file.
title: Who holds US household debt: derived quarterly tables

third_party_not_redistributed.name: S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index
third_party_not_redistributed.why: Copyrighted by S&P Dow Jones Indices; FRED says copyrighted series need the owner's permission for anything beyond personal use. Used only as context in the pipeline; in no download.

tables.name: public_share
tables.title: Public share of household mortgages and consumer credit
sources: Z.1 (FL154104015, FL153165105, FL153166000 and the holder series in pipeline/series_catalog.yaml)
tables.validation: Every quarter is recomputed independently from the raw Z.1 file by validation check D1 (validation/REPORT.md).

columns.name: date
columns.desc: Quarter end.

columns.name: scope_total_musd
columns.desc: Household 1–4 family mortgages plus consumer credit (Z.1 FL154104015), nominal.

columns.name: public_musd
columns.desc: Part of scope held by the public sector: federal government direct, GSEs and agency pools, state and local governments. Nominal.

columns.name: public_share
columns.desc: public_musd / scope_total_musd. Holdings, not guarantees: GSE-guaranteed loans held by private investors count as private.

columns.name: public_share_mortgage
columns.desc: Public share of household mortgages only (holders apportioned to households).

columns.name: public_share_cc
columns.desc: Public share of consumer credit only.

columns.name: fed_mbs_musd
columns.desc: Federal Reserve holdings of agency MBS (FRED WSHOMCB, last weekly value in the quarter). An overlay, already inside the agency pools: never add it to public_musd. Empty before 2009.

columns.name: fed_mbs_share_of_scope
columns.desc: fed_mbs_musd / scope_total_musd. Empty before 2009.

tables.name: debt_by_risk_holder
tables.title: Household debt by who holds it
tables.grain: one row per quarter × risk_bucket × debt_type
sources: FRED DSPI (disposable personal income, from BEA)
tables.validation: Produced by the pipeline (pipeline/tests). Sums are recomputed by validation checks A1–A4 and B; rows are not individually re-checked.

columns.name: date
columns.desc: Quarter end.

columns.name: risk_bucket
columns.desc: Holder group; labels and public/private flag in dim_risk_bucket.

columns.name: debt_type
columns.desc: mortgage or consumer_credit.

columns.name: nominal_musd
columns.desc: Holdings, nominal. Mortgage holders are apportioned to households: holder / all 1–4 family mortgages (FL893065105) × household mortgages (FL153165105).

columns.name: real_musd
columns.desc: Holdings in constant dollars of the CPI base quarter in meta.json (cpi_base_quarter): nominal × CPI(base) / CPI(quarter), CPI = quarterly mean of CPIAUCSL.

columns.name: share_of_total
columns.desc: Of the scope total (mortgages plus consumer credit) in that quarter.

columns.name: pct_of_dpi
columns.desc: Of disposable personal income (DSPI quarterly mean, SAAR). Despite the name, a 0–1 fraction. Empty before 1959.

tables.name: collateral_coverage
tables.title: Household debt by what backs it, and collateral coverage
tables.validation: Produced by the pipeline (pipeline/tests); not independently recomputed. Rows with is_estimated = true contain an imputation.

columns.name: date
columns.desc: Quarter end.

columns.name: collateral_class
columns.desc: home_backed (mortgages), vehicle_backed (auto loans), uncollateralized (revolving + student loans), other_nonrevolving.

columns.name: debt_musd
columns.desc: Debt in the class, nominal.

columns.name: collateral_value_musd
columns.desc: home_backed: owner-occupied real estate (FL155035015). vehicle_backed: ALL consumer durables (FL155111005), a generous proxy, so vehicle coverage is an upper bound. Empty where there is no collateral.

columns.name: coverage_ratio
columns.desc: collateral_value_musd / debt_musd. Empty where there is no collateral.

columns.name: share_of_debt
columns.desc: Of the scope total in that quarter.

columns.name: is_estimated
columns.desc: True before 2006Q1 for uncollateralized and other_nonrevolving: student loans are imputed out of other non-revolving credit (linear ramp from 1965Q4, floored at known federal, Sallie Mae and nonprofit holdings). Revolving credit is zero before 1968Q1 because the source starts then.

tables.name: crisis_event_window
tables.title: Each crisis and policy shock, two years before to four years after
tables.grain: one row per crisis × metric × quarter offset
sources: Derived from public_share, debt_by_risk_holder and collateral_coverage
tables.validation: Produced by the pipeline (pipeline/tests); not independently recomputed.

columns.name: crisis_id
columns.desc: Key into dim_crisis.

columns.name: metric
columns.desc: public_share, share:<risk_bucket or collateral_class> (share of scope total) or coverage:<collateral_class> (coverage ratio).

columns.name: q_offset
columns.desc: Quarters from the crisis start quarter (t0), −8 to +16 where data exist.

columns.name: date
columns.desc: Quarter end at that offset.

columns.name: value
columns.desc: The metric in its own unit (shares 0–1, coverage as a ratio).

columns.name: value_at_t0
columns.desc: The metric at the crisis start quarter.

columns.name: delta_from_t0
columns.desc: value − value_at_t0 in the metric's own unit: for shares, 0.05 = 5 percentage points.

tables.name: dim_crisis
tables.title: Crises and policy shocks
sources: NBER business-cycle dates (recessions); project classification (policy shocks)

columns.name: crisis_id
columns.desc: Stable key.

columns.name: name
columns.desc: Display name.

columns.name: kind
columns.desc: nber_recession or policy_shock.

columns.name: start_q
columns.desc: First quarter (t0 in crisis_event_window).

columns.name: end_q
columns.desc: Last quarter.

columns.name: notes
columns.desc: One-line description.

columns.name: risk_bucket
columns.desc: Key used in debt_by_risk_holder.

columns.name: label
columns.desc: Display name.

columns.name: is_public
columns.desc: True for federal_direct, gse_agency and state_local.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.desc: Display order.

tables.name: nyfed_by_type
tables.title: NY Fed: balances and transitions into serious delinquency by loan type
tables.grain: one row per quarter × loan_type, 2003Q1 on
tables.pending: Eleonora to decide: redistribute under the NY Fed Terms of Use with their attribution, or link only (tracks/infra.md, question F4-1). Link only until then.
sources: NY Fed Household Debt and Credit Report (Equifax Consumer Credit Panel)
tables.validation: As published by the NY Fed.

columns.name: date
columns.desc: Quarter end.

columns.name: loan_type
columns.desc: mortgage, heloc, auto, credit_card, student, other.

columns.name: balance_busd
columns.desc: Balance as published. Credit-report data: not comparable to Z.1 levels.

columns.name: transition_serious_pct
columns.desc: Percent of balance transitioning into 90+ days delinquent, annualized, as published (0–100, not 0–1).
